2609.18520.title: AeroWeaver: An Embodied-Agent Harness for Weaving Aerial Skills into Distributed, Adaptive Swarm Execution
2609.18520.paper_summary: Collective intelligence is a collaborative autonomy paradigm in which multiple agents pursue shared objectives through local perception, information exchange, and coordinated action. UAV swarms embody this paradigm by coordinating multiple vehicles in tasks such as search, inspection, and tracking. Recent advances in large language model (LLM) agents have strengthened natural-language task understanding and high-level planning, providing a flexible semantic interface between mission descriptions and collective behavior. While these advances expand semantic reasoning, applying LLM agents to UAV swarms raises challenges in grounding model decisions in executable capabilities, reconciling global task reasoning with distributed execution, and using mission-specific experience for continual adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce AeroWeaver, an embodied-agent harness that weaves individual UAV skills into coordinated mission-level behavior. AeroWeaver connects semantic decisions to governed skills, organizes role-conditioned local agents for distributed coordination, and uses role-indexed state-action-reward experience to refine skill selection online. Experiments and runtime validation show that AeroWeaver maintains valid skill execution under tested conditions and supports body-local multi-UAV operation without a central agent generating joint actions from global context, while reward-guided online updates provide a training-free path for adaptive learning swarm agents from accumulated execution experience. Code: https://github.com/Admire-ljb/AeroWeaver.
2609.18520.paper_summary_zh: 集體智慧是一種協作自主範式，其中多個代理透過地方感知、信息交流和協調行動來追求共同目標。無人機群體體現了這一範式，通過協調多輛飛行器執行搜索、檢查和追蹤等任務。最近在大型語言模型（LLM）代理方面的進展增強了自然語言任務理解和高層次規劃，提供了任務描述與集體行為之間的靈活語義介面。儘管這些進展擴展了語義推理，但將LLM代理應用於無人機群體面臨著將模型決策與可執行能力相結合、調和全球任務推理與分佈式執行以及利用特定任務經驗進行持續適應的挑戰。為了解決這些挑戰，我們介紹了AeroWeaver，一種具身代理的工具，將個別無人機技能編織成協調的任務級行為。AeroWeaver將語義決策與受控技能相連接，組織角色條件的本地代理以實現分佈式協調，並使用角色索引的狀態-行動-獎勵經驗在線優化技能選擇。實驗和運行時驗證表明，AeroWeaver在測試條件下保持有效的技能執行，並支持無需中央代理從全球上下文生成聯合行動的本地多無人機操作，同時獎勵引導的在線更新為從累積執行經驗中自適應學習的群體代理提供了無需訓練的途徑。代碼：https://github.com/Admire-ljb/AeroWeaver。
